Generate only this Python artifact, with no Markdown fences, explanation, tests, or additional text:

parse_sample_count(value: str) -> int

Accept only a non-empty string consisting of ASCII decimal digits with no leading +/-, surrounding whitespace, decimal point, or other characters. Return the base-10 integer. It must be at least 1 and at most 100000; otherwise raise ValueError. Standard library only, deterministic, no filesystem/network/global state. Examples: "1" -> 1, "008" -> 8; " 8", "8.0", "+8", "0", "100001" invalid.
